turnos.t: A storage is an amount: the carbon held in a reservoir at one time. A flow is a rate: carbon moving between stores or changing form. Photosynthesis takes carbon from the air into plants. Feeding passes it to animals. Respiration returns it to the air. Death and decomposition move it into soil. Fossilisation turns it into fossil fuels, which combustion returns to the air. And dissolution and sedimentation take it into oceans and sediments.
And they work on different timescales?
Very different. Carbon cycles in days to years through the atmosphere and living things, but can stay thousands to millions of years in fossil fuels and carbonate rock.
